Subject: FedRAMP / ISO evidence and timeline questions

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. As we scope our procurement and the security review at Acme, a few follow-ups from our side:

- Can you share a concise checklist of the artifacts you can provide for FedRAMP readiness (e.g., POA&Ms, SSP sections, evidence owners) and an approximate ETA?
- Do you have a public ISO 27001 timeline (certification target quarter) and who at Redwood is the control owner for access control and logging evidence?
- Are there any audit blackout dates in Q1 we should avoid for an on-site/remote evidence collection window?

We'd appreciate the checklist + any sample evidence files (high-level) to get procurement moving.

Best,
Sarah

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: FedRAMP / ISO evidence and timeline questions

Hi Sarah — great questions. I pulled together a short readiness checklist and attached it plus a few annotated samples (SIG/CAIQ highlights). Key points up front:

- FedRAMP readiness: we can provide an SSP draft, control mappings to NIST 800-53, inventory of evidence owners, and a prioritized list of artifacts for your procurement team. ETA: initial package within 3 business days, full annotated packet in 10 business days.
- ISO 27001: target certification quarter Q3 2027 (formal audit window planned in May–June 2027). We are currently finishing the gap remediation sprint.
- Evidence owners: Access control -> Mina Haddad (Director, Security Operations); Logging & monitoring -> Karthik Iyer (Lead SRE).
- Audit windows: we try to avoid major platform maintenance windows; current planned maintenance: 2027-01-12 to 2027-01-14 (do not schedule evidence collection then).

Attachments: Redwood_FedRAMP_Prelim_Checklist_v1.2.xlsx (checklist + owners), SIG_partial_responses_20261119.xlsx (work-in-progress), CAIQ-summary-annotated.pdf (high-level answers).

Next steps: I propose a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the checklist and identify any Acme-specific evidence gaps. Are you available Tue 11/24 or Wed 11/25?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Tim Burns <timothy.burns@auditors-inc.com>

Subject: Audit logistics — remote evidence collection options

Evelyn / Sarah — quick note from the audit side:

- For remote evidence collection we'll need secure SharePoint/secure upload with time-limited links (recommended) or an SFTP endpoint.
- Typical packet we request up front: SSP PDF, recent SOC 2 auditor report (if available), evidence excerpts for key controls (user access lists, MFA enforcement screenshots, logging retention policy).
- If Redwood plans a FedRAMP-focused SSPL draft, please flag which controls are in 'in progress' vs 'implemented' in the spreadsheet. That helps triage during our initial intake.

We can be flexible on scheduling; earliest intake review we have open is the week of 2026-12-08.

—Tim
Tim Burns
Senior Assoc., Auditors, Inc.
